name: dialis report2
query:
SELECT 
    patient AS "Patient ID:100",
    patient_name AS "Patient Name:300",
    COUNT(patient) AS "Patient Count:100",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT DAY(date) ORDER BY DAY(date)) AS "Days of Visit:200"
FROM 
    `tabDIALYSIS REPORT`
WHERE 
    date BETWEEN %(From)s AND %(To)s
GROUP BY 
    patient, patient_name
ORDER BY 
    patient;  -- Use the original column name here
